assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not capture these distinct dimensions at the individual member level: 1) Economic maintenance: While Section G (OFEMP2) asks about receiving unemployment benefits and Section H (SIDIV1) asks if the individual receives pensions, the survey does not capture income or support amounts across all sources (wages, informal work, pensions, remittances) per individual member. 2) Labor burden: Section C (Q34) captures hours spent in paid work, but no section captures hours spent in unpaid domestic or care work (Section H, Q1 only records dedication to household tasks as a general status category). 3) Property and asset control: Section HG1 examines shared household budgets, but individual ownership or control of dwelling, land, or assets is not captured. 4) Decision-making: Section C (Q30) asks who decides the respondent's work schedule, but no questions address intra-household decision-making spheres such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices.
